# Haystack: a low-poly dome 1.6 m across and 1.05 m tall (an 8-segment sphere, its lower half deleted). Up Z.
new
add mesh uv-sphere --name Hay --segments 8 --rings 6 --radius 0.8 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 1 1.3
apply --scale
material new Hay --base-color 0.580 0.890 0.267
mode edit
select all
select vert where "pos.z < -0.01"
delete vert
select all
randomize --amount 0.04 --seed 2
mode object
shade flat
export haystack.glb
